messages:
Incident Bot: PAGED oncall-sre — hf model fetch errors spiking (root cause: third-party rate limits). Please acknowledge.
PagerDuty: Incident opened: hf-model-fetch-throttle — severity: high — routed to oncall-sre.
Sara (oncall): acked. seeing ~20% of cold-starts failing with model pull errors. customers hitting inference 503s.
Ben: I can see backend metrics — prefetch spool errors up 18x since 09:12 UTC. stack traces show remote 429s from model-hosting API.
Priya: uploading recent prefetch logs to /var/logs/prefetch/2026-03-15.log — snippet:
```
[09:11:54] fetch_model("gpt-like-v2") -> HTTP 429
{\n  "status": 429,\n  "message": "Rate limit exceeded",\n  "retry_after": "30"\n}
```
Marco: runtime is retrying with exponential backoff but cold start path is synchronous — if model fetch never returns we fail the request. we need a mitigation ASAP.
Eli (support): support queue is seeing customers reporting timeouts and 503s, notably customers A and C. NPS impact flagged.
Nia (CS): Customer A is on a demo call in 20m. escalating to account lead.
Ben: quick mitigation options: 1) enable local disk cache fallback (serve stale model if last-known artifact exists) 2) switch affected tenants to smaller local cached model variant 3) route fetches to mirror (if we have a cached copy in S3) 4) throttle new coldstart attempts via circuit breaker.
Sara (oncall): prioritize options 1 and 4 now. Marco - can you flip stale-model fallback? Priya - can we surface which models/tenants are impacted?
Marco: I can flip fallback to "serve_stale_on_fetch_failure" in the config for hosted runtime. rolling flag to 2 regions now. command:
```
# toggle flag
redwoodctl feature-set runtime.serve_stale_on_fetch_failure true --env prod --region us-west
```
Marco: rolling — pushing to 10% of hosts first.
Priya: querying prefetch logs to map tenants -> model ids. partial list: tenant-A -> gpt-like-v2, tenant-C -> embedder-compact-1. will post full list in 5m.
OpsBot: Alert: HF model-hosting status page reports elevated error rates: https://status.huggingface.co — message: "We are experiencing rate limiting issues on artifact serving"
HF Status: We are investigating increased 429 responses from the model hub CDN. Working on increasing per-client throttling windows.
Ben: while fallback rolls, apply circuit breaker to limit concurrent cold-start model fetches to 10 (was 60). command:
```
# limit concurrent prefetch
redwoodctl config set prefetch.concurrent_coldstarts 10 --env prod
```
Sara (oncall): done. reduced concurrency should cut pressure on HF.
Eli (support): noted immediate drop in customer-facing 503s for tenant-A. still some degraded latency.
Priya: posting mapping now:
- tenant-A: gpt-like-v2
- tenant-B: doc-tuned-2
- tenant-C: embedder-compact-1
- tenant-D: open-lm-30b (prefetch disabled previously)
Priya: for large models (open-lm-30b) we still see work queueing — recommend temporarily routing those tenants to a hosted dedicated instance (if they have contracts) or to a smaller quantized variant.
Nia (CS): running outreach for impacted customers with status blurb. will coordinate mitigation credits if SLA breached.
Sara (oncall): next steps: 1) keep stale fallback enabled 2) keep concurrent coldstart cap 3) attempt S3 mirror pulls for models that have copies 4) open support case with HF for rate limit increase / whitelisting 5) track customer impact list.
Marco: starting S3 mirror attempt for gpt-like-v2:
```
# try s3 fallback
redwoodctl artifact-fetch --model gpt-like-v2 --source s3://redwood-mirror/gpt-like-v2.tar.gz
```
Marco: S3 has a mirror of gpt-like-v2 from last sync (2026-03-14). pull succeeded on first host.
Ben: adding temporary routing rule so tenant-A and tenant-C fetch from S3 mirror first:
```
redwoodctl routing add-rule --match tenant in (A,C) --artifact-source s3-mirror
```
Ben: rule applied.
Eli (support): tenant-A confirmed demo resumed. customer says "latency weird but working" :thumbsup:.
Sara (oncall): contacting HF support now — Priya, can you capture a concise packet of errors + request whitelisting? include sample 429 headers and our service IP blocks.
Priya: filing ticket: SUPPORT-8921 -> message: "High volume 429s on artifact fetch from HF hub; impacting cold starts. Request temporary rate window increase for IPs x.x.x.0/24 & y.y.y.0/24." attaching logs.
HF Status: Ticket received (ref #HF-4529). We have applied a temporary increase for those IP ranges; monitoring.
OpsBot: Metric spike normalized: prefetch 429 rate decreased from 22% -> 4% in last 3m.
Ben: keeping an eye on error budgets. suggest alert suppression for noise while we confirm stable.
Sara (oncall): I want a timeline and RCA draft. Marco/Priya/BEn — please collect artifacts: prefetched logs, routing changes, HF ticket, S3 mirror pulls. label incident hf-hosting-throttle-20260315.
Nia (CS): customer outreach messages being sent. will update if any major SLA issues.
Eli (support): closing this thread for active paging once we hit stable for 15m. moving to postmortem channel after that.
PagerDuty: Incident hf-model-fetch-throttle acknowledged by Sara. will auto-resolve on stable metric condition.
Sara (oncall): moving to monitoring — will handoff to postmortem in ~1h. thanks team. :heart:
